lines.text: Moses says to return a brother's straying ox or sheep, and to take it home if he lives far away.
Moses says to let the mother bird go and to build a railing around a new roof.
When a husband falsely accuses his wife, her father and mother bring proof to the priests, and he pays fifty shekels.

wrong_details.true: the city elders at the gate

lines.text: A man found with another man's wife must die, and a betrothed woman attacked in the open country is stoned.

wrong_details.wrong: a betrothed woman attacked in the open country is stoned
wrong_details.true: Do nothing to the young woman; only the man must die

lines.text: A man who seizes an unpledged virgin must pay her father fifty shekels and marry her, and he must not marry his father's wife.
